title: Retirement of the Windows Hostinger completed-build evidence fallback

phases.objective: Retire the incident-specific completed-build evidence bridge while preserving the canonical GET-only evidence collector and a regression that prevents silent re-registration.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository governance evaluator and canonical Hostinger evidence collector
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact pull-request tree after retirement of the incident-specific evidence bridge.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The retired workflow is absent, the canonical GET-only collector remains tracked, and no provider mutation or Production authority is introduced.
steps: Verify the incident-specific workflow path is absent from the exact candidate tree.
Run the repository-wide runner-context and retired-workflow regression.
Run the canonical Hostinger completed-build evidence contract without credential access.
Verify every declared evidence path resolves to a tracked regular file.
assertions: The retired workflow cannot be registered or triggered.
The canonical evidence workflow remains GET-only and fail-closed.
No deployment, restart, provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref update, force push, or external business send occurs.
Secrets are neither read by the regression nor included in evidence.

phases.objective: Merge inert registration, then merge exactly one marker-only trigger and read the evidence result.
The incident-specific bridge is retired; resilience is enforced by the canonical collector and repository lifecycle regression rather than a second runtime surface.
GET-only evidence performs no provider mutation.
The workflow does not deploy, activate, or restart Production.
